card.text: Explore Eris with an illustrative NASA texture on its occultation-constrained spherical shape.

introduction.text: Eris is a bright, icy dwarf planet in the distant outer Solar System. Its surface is shown using NASA’s illustrative model texture; no spacecraft has mapped it.

illustration.title: Surface illustration
illustration.summary: The depicted terrain is imagined, not photographed. The real surface is unresolved, and the displayed coordinates are arbitrary.
